purpose: Proof-of-reuse source associations to Bible Atlas and cinematic research scenes without misrepresenting physical artwork identity, source passage, or live photo deployment.
policy: 6 editorial connections derived from exact scene titles and passages, NOT blanket title keyword co-occurrence
The user 5-star image may depict a subepisode only; event-level media can link to it as a candidate, never claim it shows all verses
No single image becomes automatically published to live atlas; rights, image identity, crop and scene-source checks remain
W49 photo mismatches and W49 0-2 physical rejections never promoted
Keep 151 canonical production event count distinct from 183 cinematic research scenes
Saints Map links to martyr saints are not automatically mapped to Bible event coordinates
